dedupe_keys.name: rainfall induced landslide susceptibility maps using giri model

description: Rosa Maria Palau and colleagues publish global rainfall-induced landslide susceptibility maps calculated with the GIRI method. Zenodo offers two tiled raster ZIP archives under CC BY 4.0 at no cost, one using W5E5 rainfall for 1979–2016 and one using IPSL-CM6A-LR SSP1-2.6 climate input for 2061–2100. The maps classify terrain into five susceptibility levels using slope, land cover, lithology and mean monthly rainfall. They can supply landslide hazard layers for road, railway or utility exposure simulations. The catalogue’s data-giri-global-infrastructure-risk record describes the broader GIRI portal; this separately published map release has different files and scenario coverage. A limitation is that susceptibility class is not event probability or a local geotechnical assessment. Tile seams, source-resolution differences and future climate assumptions need checking before merging with asset maps. No ZIP was downloaded or raster result tested.
